mapper.select: SELECT p.post_code AS postCode, p.user_code AS userCode, u.nickname AS nickname, NULL AS profileImage, FALSE AS isFollowing, FALSE AS featured, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.post_content AS postContent, p.post_type AS postType, p.store_code AS storeCode, s.store_name AS storeName, p.challenge_code AS challengeCode, c.challenge_title AS challengeTitle, CASE WHEN pl.user_code IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS liked, COALESCE(lc.like_count, 0) AS likeCount, COALESCE(cc.comment_count, 0) AS commentCount FROM post p JOIN users u ON p.user_code = u.user_code LEFT JOIN store s ON p.store_code = s.store_code LEFT JOIN challenge c ON p.challenge_code = c.challenge_code LEFT JOIN post_like pl ON pl.post_code = p.post_code AND pl.user_code = #{userCode}::uuid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT post_code, COUNT(*) AS like_count FROM post_like GROUP BY post_code ) lc ON lc.post_code = p.post_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT post_code, COUNT(*) AS comment_count FROM post_comment WHERE comment_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY post_code ) cc ON cc.post_code = p.post_code WHERE p.post_code = #{postCode} AND p.post_status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT image_code AS imageCode, 'POST' AS referenceType, post_code AS referenceCode, path AS path, origin_name AS originName, file_name AS fileName, "order" AS "order" FROM image WHERE post_code = #{postCode} ORDER BY "order" ASC, image_code ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_like (post_code, user_code) VALUES (#{postCode}, #{userCode}::uuid) ON CONFLICT (post_code, user_code) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_like WHERE post_code = #{postCode}

SELECT pc.comment_code AS commentCode, pc.post_code AS postCode, pc.user_code AS userCode, u.nickname AS nickname, NULL AS profileImage, pc.comment_content AS commentContent, pc.created_at AS createdAt FROM post_comment pc JOIN users u ON pc.user_code = u.user_code WHERE pc.post_code = #{postCode} AND pc.comment_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY pc.created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_comment (post_code, user_code, comment_content) VALUES (#{postCode}, #{userCode}::uuid, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT pc.comment_code AS commentCode, pc.post_code AS postCode, pc.user_code AS userCode, u.nickname AS nickname, NULL AS profileImage, pc.comment_content AS commentContent, pc.created_at AS createdAt FROM post_comment pc JOIN users u ON pc.user_code = u.user_code WHERE pc.comment_code = #{commentCode}
SELECT user_code FROM post_comment WHERE comment_code = #{commentCode}
